_comment: Copy to roles/<role_id>.json. The roles/ directory is gitignored.
_scenario_note: Country-restricted ATS: the platform's location field only accepts country granularity, so 'ats_location' uses 'country_only' (reads profile.location_facts.country_of_residence). CV contact line stays on 'remote_label' for a global remote posting.
title: Senior Backend Engineer
openness: Open to fully remote roles working across global timezones.

location_strategy._comment: Optional per-role override of profile.location_strategy_defaults. Same keys and values. Set 'inherit' to fall through to the profile-level default; omit a key to inherit implicitly. Supported values: inherit, hide, remote_label, current_residence, country_only, role_location, custom:<key>, generated_role_specific.

paragraphs: Opening paragraph — specific hook to GlobalCo's distributed engineering culture...

experience_overrides._comment: Optional: override specific bullets for this role. Leave empty to use profile defaults.
